claude.rationale: The acquired entity was merged out of existence and deregistered (Form 15-12B, Oct 2017), leaving no post-closing 10-K for the ~2020-2022 window. The acquirer's FY2020 and FY2021 Forms 10-K contain zero occurrences of "Potomac," and no primary source or reputable press isolates any disposition, impairment, or operational fracture specifically attributable to the former First Potomac portfolio. With no realized-outcome evidence of product/process incoherence or process/organization fracture separately documented for this business, both p4 and p5 are uncertain per the no-record convention; no inference is drawn from the acquirer's consolidated results.
